title: Workflow generation requests
note: Queue for the workflow studio: the UI posts a request record per new workflow (item = workflow name); the worker on the always-on mini polls the repo, runs the real task-breakdown skill via headless Claude Code, commits the build, and posts status records (reviewer 'mini-worker': status queued|running|done|failed) to the same item. Request verdict: {action:'generate', name, input, requested_by}. The mini being down just queues requests — the studio shows request age. TI-5 (2026-08-27) adds one more action on the SAME queue and the SAME 60s tick — no second queue, no second scheduler: {action:'teardown-run', source, brand, creator?, video_count?} runs components/video-teardown/machine/run.py end to end on the mini, dev lane. A request names a SOURCE and never a command, prompt or stage list (rule 8); ran_by on the resulting run is the requester from the record filename and venue is 'mini', so the run is legible on the teardowns viewer as that person's. A missing vendor key refuses BEFORE stage 1 and the request is recorded failed, never done. CR-4 (2026-09-02) adds a SECOND engine on that same queue and tick, and again no new kind and no new destination: {action:'chain-run', chain, config?, vars?, model_runner?, out?} runs components/chain-runner/runner/run.py, dev lane, capped at 1800s, defaulting to the 'stub' model runner that calls nothing. The run directory lands OUTSIDE every checkout (~/chain-runner-runs/<run>) and the request's request/running/done records are the only thing filed — where chain-runner runs surface for VIEWING was ruled 2026-09-02 ('CR 3 yes': same teardowns view, engine-tagged) and is CR-3's slice to wire — the adapter itself still writes only these job records, never teardown-runs or a view.
